international.title: Apec summit live: Xi and Putin speak as world leaders gather in China
international.summary: Summit in Chinese tech hub Shenzhen set to include highly anticipated meeting between Xi, Trump and Putin Shenzhen takes centre stage as Xi sends ‘Chinamaxxing’ message at Apec summit What is Apec? Explained in 30 seconds It’s been a big week already for diplomatic summits , with the most anticipated among them, the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) leader’s meeting, starting today in the Chinese tech hub of Shenzen. Some observers have noted that we could be about to witness a Yalta 2.0 , a reference to a major 1945 wartime conference attended by Churchill, Roosevelt and Stalin. China’s foreign ministry said the leaders “will exchange views in-depth on safeguarding world peace and promoting strategic stability in major-power relations, which is of groundbreaking significance”. The ministry added that: “Stronger communication among China, Russia and the United States, along ​with managing differences and stabilising relations, serves the interests of all three countries.” The Kremlin said: “The significance and symbolism of this meeting are hard to overestimate. ” But it has dismissed comparisons with the 1945 Yalta meeting saying they were just “games of political scientists”. In a call this week, China’s top diplomat, Wang Yi, and the US secretary of state, Marco Rubio , “agreed on the importance of meaningful leader-level conversations to advance goals such as peace and denuclearisation”, the US state department said.
